categories.main_business_segments: SMIC is a leading integrated circuit wafer foundry company primarily engaged in semiconductor wafer manufacturing and testing. It offers 8-inch and 12-inch wafer foundry services, design services, IP support, photomask manufacturing, and related one-stop supporting services. The company also promotes upstream and downstream collaboration in the integrated circuit industry chain to provide comprehensive IC solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: SMIC possesses a comprehensive integrated circuit wafer foundry core technology system with multiple technology platforms for 8-inch and 12-inch wafers. It develops advanced process nodes including 28nm ultra-low leakage, 55nm high-voltage display, 65nm RF SOI, 90nm BCD, and embedded memory platforms. The company follows a rigorous R&D process from project selection to mass production, emphasizing technology iteration, platform construction, and IP development. Manufacturing involves small batch trial production, risk production, and mass production stages aligned with customer requirements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: SMIC serves global customers including integrated circuit design companies and IDM enterprises across various sectors such as smartphones, computers and tablets, consumer electronics, IoT and wearable devices, industrial and automotive electronics. Its customer base is diversified with no single customer accounting for more than 10% of total revenue. The company collaborates with leading enterprises in consumer electronics, automotive, IoT, industrial control, and AI industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: SMIC operates primarily in Mainland China with major manufacturing facilities in Shanghai, Beijing, Tianjin, Shenzhen, and other locations. It maintains international marketing and service offices in the United States, Europe, Japan, and Taiwan to support global customers. The majority of its revenue is generated from the China region (about 84.6%), followed by the US (12.4%) and Eurasia (3%).
categories.supply_chain_position: SMIC operates as a midstream semiconductor foundry in the integrated circuit supply chain, providing wafer manufacturing and related technical services. It collaborates closely with upstream suppliers of raw materials, equipment, and software, as well as downstream customers including chip designers and packaging/testing companies, forming an integrated ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-driven growth, focusing on high-quality development and technology leadership. It invests heavily in R&D (9.4% of revenue in 2024) to advance process nodes and platform technologies, emphasizing low power, high voltage, RF, and embedded memory solutions. SMIC also strengthens ecosystem collaboration with industry leaders, academia, and research institutes to foster forward-looking projects and build a distinctive industrial chain and innovation chain. Talent retention and green sustainable development are also strategic priorities.
categories.revenue_model: SMIC generates revenue primarily through wafer foundry service fees based on wafer sales, including 8-inch and 12-inch wafers. It also earns income from design services, IP support, photomask manufacturing, and other ancillary services. The company uses a direct sales model, engaging customers with tailored solutions and contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: SMIC is ranked as the second largest pure-play wafer foundry globally and the largest in Mainland China. It competes with global industry leaders but currently has a technology gap compared to the top-tier foundries. The company leverages its capacity scale, localized supply chain, and platform diversity to strengthen its market position amid intense global competition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, SMIC achieved record sales revenue of RMB 57.8 billion, a 28% year-on-year increase, with a gross margin of 19% and capacity utilization of 85.6%. Total assets reached approximately RMB 353 billion. The company sold 8.02 million 8-inch equivalent wafers, a 36.7% increase from the prior year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 3.7 billion, down 23.3% due to lower investment income. The company maintains strong cash flow and continues capital expenditure focused on capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: SMIC emphasizes its comprehensive technology platforms, strong R&D capabilities, and integrated one-stop service model to provide customers with tailored, high-quality wafer foundry solutions. Its competitive advantages include a broad product portfolio covering logic, power/analog, RF, embedded memory, and image sensors, combined with a robust IP and patent portfolio. The company’s internationalized operations and localized supply chain enhance supply stability and responsiveness, delivering value through innovation, quality, and ecosystem collaboration.
